supersedes.reason: Phase 3 evidence serialization was correctness-expanded before any Phase 4 model ran; the selected conclusions are unchanged but the bound result hash changed.

objective: Falsify whether the qualified breadth association is incremental to fixed observed trend controls.

method.partial_rank: Residual correlation after pooled percentile ranks, fixed control ranks and entry-year dummies; binary outcomes remain 0/1
method.trend_strata: quintiles of mean within-year control ranks; top versus bottom breadth terciles

support_gate: At least two breadth features have partial rho >=0.10 for MFE or winner_ge20, positive sign in >=7/8 LOYO estimates, positive top-minus-bottom effect in >=4/5 trend strata, and no winner_ge50 partial rho <=-0.10.
